narrative.overview: The visual world is inspired by the meticulous clarity of laboratory research documents, academic monographs, and analytical instrumentation. The foundational experience is anchored in a high-contrast Light Mode that evokes clinical, crisp pearl-white archival paper (oklch(0.985 0.003 250)), deep technical charcoal ink typography (oklch(0.20 0.008 260)), and an electric ultraviolet / spectral cobalt accent (oklch(0.58 0.22 278)) that functions with laser-like precision.
keyCharacteristics: Clinical Pearl Canvas: An impeccably clean, high-luminance light surface (oklch(0.985 0.003 250)) with a microscopic cool mineral undertone.
Technical Charcoal Ink: Deep, legible charcoal (oklch(0.20 0.008 260)) avoiding the harshness of absolute #000000 while maintaining superior contrast.
Electric Ultraviolet Accent: A laser-sharp spectral cobalt/ultraviolet accent (oklch(0.58 0.22 278)) for active triggers, focal points, and focus rings.
Zero-Shadow Discipline: Completely flat planar elevation structured by single-pixel hairline dividers and subtle pointer illumination.
Analytical Typography: Contrast between light-weight humanist grotesque display typography and rigorous monospaced technical labels.

rules.name: The Ultraviolet Precision Rule
rules.body: The electric ultraviolet accent is an instrument of precision: it is restricted strictly to active hover states, link chevrons, expanded cursor magnification, and primary CTA pills (≤ 5% of viewport area). It is never deployed as decorative background fill or text paragraph highlights.

rules.name: The Kinetic Restraint Rule
rules.body: Kinetic typographic shifts follow mouse coordinates but remain bounded (≤ 1.4px per letter) and are deactivated completely when prefers-reduced-motion is detected.

rules.name: The Zero Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat by definition. Depth is created by cursor-driven light, shared layoutId morphs, and tonal contrast—never blur-radius box-shadows.

dos: Do maintain the clinical pearl-white canvas (oklch(0.985 0.003 250)) as the default base environment.
Do keep primary text in technical charcoal (oklch(0.20 0.008 260)), preserving high contrast without harsh pure black.
Do restrict the electric ultraviolet accent (oklch(0.58 0.22 278)) to precision focal points and interactive signals.
Do use Geist Mono for all categorical, technical, and numerical metadata.
Do test all animations and cursor tracking against prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't reintroduce warm cream, yellow, or terracotta tints into the background or text.
Don't add box-shadows, skeuomorphic bevels, or heavy glow filters.
Don't use neon cyan, purple gradient meshes, or generic cyber tropes; keep the ultraviolet accent razor-sharp and restrained.
Don't clutter project entries with excessive decorative chips or badges.
Don't use pure #000000 black for primary body copy.
